# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **$7.0M platform GMV with balanced dual-channel adoption** — eCat processed 2,712 orders over the trailing 12 months split nearly 50/50 between iPad ($4.6M, $3,394 AOV) and eCat Online ($2.4M, $1,776 AOV), indicating both rep-driven and self-service channels are actively engaged. [→ §commerce]
2. **eCat is the primary transaction system** — Platform GMV ($7.0M) exceeds synced all-channel total ($2.5M), confirming eCat handles the majority of order volume rather than supplementing other channels. [→ §commerce]
3. **Low buyer concentration reduces key-account risk** — Top 5 accounts represent approximately 11% of total eCat GMV over trailing 12 months, with no single buyer exceeding 2.7% — growth depends on broad engagement, not a handful of relationships. [→ §commerce]
4. **iPad AOV premium signals healthy channel differentiation** — iPad orders average $3,394 vs. $1,776 for eCat Online (1.9x), reflecting reps handling complex high-value transactions while buyers self-serve routine reorders. [→ §commerce]
